## Display Social Icons in Header Top Bar

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/display-social-icons-in-header-top-bar/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Social Icons

Social Icons on the site provide the visitors/audiences a way to connect with you on various social platforms. You can check the box to display the Social Icons on the Top header of the site on the Spacious site.
